item.coloph: kun grol grags chen po / 'bri klung mkhar gsum mdo yi lcog sgar du / shing khyi hor zla bcu pa'i tshes la dge / phyis su khro chen kun dga'i [~dgas] spar bskrun tshe / sangs rgyas kyis dag ther byas …
item.note: there is reference in the colophon to a printing by the khro-chen king kun-dga' subsequent to the composition of the work in the year 1754.
